# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.22

A light housekeeping release, plus an updated setup guide for advanced users running the wrapper tool on a separate computer.

### Notes

- Mostly internal housekeeping this round, alongside an updated step-by-step guide for setting up the wrapper on a separate machine (such as a Raspberry Pi or home server) — nothing changes in how the app itself behaves.
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
